lead.title: Safety Advisory 2026-02: Advanced Chemistry Battery Hazards in Passenger Railcar Operations
lead.summary: FRA is issuing Safety Advisory 2026-02 to alert the passenger rail industry to severe safety risks associated with advanced chemistry batteries carried aboard passenger railcars within electric micromobility vehicles. The advisory recommends specific operational, training, and emergency planning and response mitigations.

leads.title: Safety Advisory 2026-02: Advanced Chemistry Battery Hazards in Passenger Railcar Operations
leads.summary: FRA is issuing Safety Advisory 2026-02 to alert the passenger rail industry to severe safety risks associated with advanced chemistry batteries carried aboard passenger railcars within electric micromobility vehicles. The advisory recommends specific operational, training, and emergency planning and response mitigations.

leads.title: Zipline Proposes Up to 130,000 Daily Drone Deliveries in Arizona, With 24-Hour Operations
leads.summary: Zipline is seeking Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) approval for up to 130,000 daily drone deliveries across Phoenix and Tucson, with 24-hour operations. The proposal includes up to 65 charging locations and 1,300 package dropboxes in each area, using Platform 2 aircraft that carry packages up to eight pounds. The FAA is reviewing the draft environmental assessment and accepting public comments until December 7 or 9, 2026.

leads.title: AeroVironment receives USD405 million international order for LOCUST X3 laser systems
leads.summary: AeroVironment received a USD405 million international order for LOCUST X3 laser systems to counter Group 1-3 uncrewed aircraft in the Middle East. The company plans to establish an undisclosed in-country maintenance depot for regional support and training.

stories.title: White House Puts Drone Security at the Top of Its Agenda
The Hidden Risks of Automated Drone Missions on Construction Sites
stories.summary: The UK’s Air Accidents Investigation Branch reported that a drone conducting an aerial survey in the Cheetham Hill area of Manchester struck a tower crane and fell approximately 120 metres. The drone had its obstacle avoidance system enabled, but an internal investigation found the company and pilots may not have fully understood the software's limitations.

stories.title: Ondas Reports 16-Fold Revenue Growth as Defense Drone Business Expands
stories.summary: Ondas Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $167.5 million, more than 16 times the $10.1 million reported a year earlier. The company attributed its growth to acquisitions and increased demand across its defense, counter-drone, and autonomous systems businesses.

stories.title: Six AGIBOT G2 Robots Complete 1,730 Tasks in 24-Hour Shanghai Convenience Store Trial
stories.summary: AGIBOT completed a 24-hour trial of six G2 robots at a Shanghai convenience store, performing 1,730 tasks including customer service and restocking. Four robots passed the final performance assessment, and the company plans to continue testing across additional real-world environments.

stories.title: Doodle Labs and XTEND AI Robotics, Inc. Expand Strategic Partnership to Bring Resilient Connectivity to XOS-Powered Systems
stories.summary: Doodle Labs and XTEND AI Robotics, Inc. expanded their strategic partnership to integrate Doodle Labs’ radios with XOS software across XTEND’s active platforms. Hardware integration is currently complete on the company’s STRIKER drone, which was awarded a $40.5 million order for 6,000 systems on October 13, 2026.

stories.title: Hawaiian Electric Uses Cyberhawk Drones to Identify Power Line Problems Before They Spark Wildfires
stories.summary: Hawaiian Electric contracted UK-based Cyberhawk to conduct aerial inspections of electrical infrastructure in wildfire risk areas on Hawaii Island, Maui County, and Oahu. Inspections began in mid-October and are scheduled to continue through December, using Skydio X10 drones to identify defects that could ignite blazes.

stories.title: Hermeus recruits Northrop Grumman to Quarterhorse drone program
stories.summary: Northrop Grumman is partnering with Hermeus to supply integrated mission systems for the startup’s Quarterhorse drone. Northrop Program Manager Kyle Mimken said the company expects to begin trials of elements of its mission-system kit in testing environments in the summer.

stories.title: European Commission launches call for cellular-based dual-use drone detection capabilities
stories.summary: The European Commission launched a call for expression of interest to gather information on testing and deploying cellular-based dual-use drone detection capabilities. The initiative covers connected and non-connected drones, inviting Member States and private partners to submit proposals, with Ukraine eligible to participate in consortia. Following this exercise, the Commission intends to explore publishing an official funding call to support piloting these detection and counter-drone response capabilities across the Union.

stories.title: Interview: How finance is shaping Wisk’s next aircraft with acting CFO Drake Berglund
stories.summary: Wisk acting CFO Drake Berglund explained how commercial requirements and battery decisions are shaping the development of the company's Gen 6 aircraft. Wisk adjusted its design to support market requirements, including a larger fuselage and additional passenger capacity, while assessing major engineering decisions against an estimated cost target of $4 per passenger mile.

stories.title: UK to buy three new mine-hunting drone motherships under Norway agreement
RDC-led shareholders takes stake in New Jersey freight and Polar Express train operator
stories.summary: Railroad Development Corp-led shareholders acquired a 50% stake in New Jersey freight and tourist train operator Morristown & Erie Railway, with the remaining 50% owned by several families that have held shares for two generations.

stories.title: How Rhoda AI is using video data to create generalized AI models for robots
Preliminary studies completed for Guatemala light rail project
stories.summary: Plans for a light rail system in Ciudad de Guatemala have moved forward following the completion of Phase 0 preliminary technical studies. Congress has also approved special legislation to govern development of the proposed MetroRiel network.

stories.title: Researchers develop wearable interface for non-visual, tactile drone control
stories.summary: Researchers at Jeonbuk National University developed a wearable interface that controls drones using hand gestures and a waist belt with 36 vibration motors. The system achieved 97.58 percent gesture-recognition accuracy and 82.75 percent tactile position accuracy, though tactile-only operation averaged 45.1 seconds compared to 31.4 seconds for visual control.

also.title: Jeonbuk National University Develops Wearable Interface for Non-Visual Drone Control

stories.title: New Dronetag receiver tackles a major Remote ID detection gap for DFR

also.title: Dronetag’s second generation Remote ID receiver extends range

stories.title: EHang completes first passenger-carrying eVTOL flights in Sri Lanka
stories.summary: EHang’s EH216‑S completed Sri Lanka’s first human-car­ry­ing eVTOL flights in Colom­bo on 11 Novem­ber 2026. The aircraft is designed to oper­ate with­out an onboard pilot.

stories.title: Beyond Aero introduces AI engineering system for hydrogen-electric aircraft programme
Archer Reports Q3 Results, FAA Certificate Clears Way for Los Angeles Flights
SkyDrive Secures Investment from Tobu Group to Develop Kanto eVTOL Network
Bulgaria and Spain form C-UAS procurement agreement as “Russian Gerber drone” found
stories.summary: Bulgaria signed a memorandum of understanding with Spain for the purchase of counter-unmanned aerial systems technologies, with Spain taking the lead role in purchasing up to 20 units. The agreement follows Bulgarian Defence Minister Dimitar Stoyanov’s comments to parliament on 14 October regarding NATO’s C-UAS initiative and maritime drone strikes.

stories.title: SkyGrid and MIT Lincoln Laboratory to stress-test AAM weather forecasting models
stories.summary: SkyGrid extended its Cooperative Research and Development Agreement with MIT Lincoln Laboratory to mature high-resolution weather forecast models for Advanced Air Mobility operations through July 2027. The partnership will stress-test these models against hazards at U.S. sites, integrating data from surface weather stations, aircraft reports, radiosondes, NEXRAD, and LIDAR to improve accuracy for low-altitude conditions.

stories.title: Railway supply industry news round-up
stories.summary: Göteborg’s municipal transport operator donated the first of a fleet of M29 trams to Mykolaiv, Ukraine. The vehicle has arrived at its new home in Ukraine.

stories.title: WSJ Op-Ed on Kyiv's Drone Dome Pitches a Fix Its Author Sells
stories.summary: A Wall Street Journal op-ed published November 12 recommends lightweight metal-coated materials to shield military electronics from jamming, a product line sold by author Robert Brüll’s company, FibreCoat. The article notes that Brüll’s recommended shielding cannot fully stop the jamming used in Ukraine’s Kyiv drone dome, which was announced on November 2 by Ukrainian presidential adviser Serhii Beskrestnov.

stories.title: Quantum Systems Hack: Fake Update Got German Military Drones Grounded
stories.summary: The German military grounded its Quantum Systems drones after attackers planted malware on the company’s update server and disguised it as a routine QBase update. The Bundeswehr declared a flight ban on the drones in Germany, while Quantum Systems says its fleet is operational and customers outside Germany remain in regular use.

stories.title: Zelensky Says Starshield's 100 mph Cap Is Back. SpaceX Says It's False
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Thursday, November 12, that Starshield is again cutting out on anything moving faster than 100 mph (161 km/h). SpaceX answered Axios the same day: “This is false. There has been no change.”

stories.title: Ukraine's StarGate Drone Has Flown Six Wounded Out of the Kill Zone
stories.summary: Ukraine's 475th Separate Assault Regiment has flown six wounded soldiers out of the kill zone on SkyFall's StarGate drone since late October. The regiment is now forming platoons dedicated to drone airlifts, with SkyFall expecting to build about 1,000 StarGates a month by the end of 2026.

stories.title: Ukraine Gives Allies Its Drone War Footage Free To Train AI Weapons
stories.summary: Ukraine is opening Avengers Labs, its Defense Ministry archive of battlefield footage, to defense companies in allied countries at no charge. Up to 12 British companies are first in line under the only agreement reached so far, and Kyiv is in talks with other governments, The New York Times reported on Thursday, November 12.

stories.title: Amazon Cites FAA Wildlife Review for Nampa. FAA Index Lists No File
stories.summary: Amazon told Idaho News 6 that every Prime Air operation undergoes a Federal Aviation Administration environmental review evaluating wildlife, but the FAA’s public index listed no Idaho document on November 12. The company stated it is evaluating options for Nampa, including changes to flight paths to reduce the concentration of flights over certain areas.

stories.title: Wing Beats Amazon to Memphis With Walmart Drones at $19.99 an Order
stories.summary: Wing began delivering Walmart orders by drone in the Memphis area on Tuesday, November 10, from three Supercenters in Bartlett, Cordova, and West Memphis. The service charges $19.99 per order, carries up to 2.75 pounds, and is Wing’s first market in Tennessee.

stories.title: DJI M300 Crash Prompts Mandatory Arm-Lock Checks for UK Police Drone Teams
stories.summary: The AAIB reported that a DJI M300 crashed in West Bridgford, Nottinghamshire, after the rear right motor arm was not correctly installed. The operator issued a Safety Notice introducing mandatory pre-flight checks of the motor arm locking mechanism.

also.title: Police DJI M300 Fell 380 Feet. The Force's Checklist Skipped the Arms

stories.title: ApusNeo HAPS Completes Record-Breaking 100-Hour Flight in EuropeanAirspace
stories.summary: UAVOS completed a 100-hour, 50-minute flight with its ApusNeo HAPS aircraft, taking off from Fuerteventura Technology Park in the Canary Islands, Spain, on November 2 and landing on November 6. The aircraft reached a maximum altitude of 14,500 meters (47,600 ft) while operating under the ISSEC R&D project led by Telespazio Ibérica.

stories.title: US Department of War awards DroneSec contract for counter-UAS threat intelligence
stories.summary: The US Department of War awarded DroneSec a contract to provide intelligence products and threat analysis on adversary uncrewed systems. The agreement integrates adversary threat intelligence into capability development and operational planning to improve situational awareness and align countermeasures with threats faced by military personnel.

stories.title: Instead of stockpiling small attack drones, Army looking to simply buy new ones
stories.summary: The Army plans to fly small drones until they break rather than stockpiling them, citing rapid obsolescence and lower replacement costs. Jon Strzelec, advanced manufacturing lead for small drones at Army Materiel Command, stated that it is cheaper to manufacture new units than to repair existing ones.

also.title: Army Official: Crashed Attack Drones Get Replaced, Not Repaired

stories.title: Safety Advisory 2026-02: Advanced Chemistry Battery Hazards in Passenger Railcar Operations
stories.summary: FRA is issuing Safety Advisory 2026-02 to alert the passenger rail industry to severe safety risks associated with advanced chemistry batteries carried aboard passenger railcars within electric micromobility vehicles. The advisory recommends specific operational, training, and emergency planning and response mitigations.

stories.title: Cry ‘drone,’ and let slip the fruit flies of war
Merlin Wins $500,000 AFRICOM Contract for Autonomous Casualty Evacuation Demonstration
Hitachi Rail opens C$30m Toronto rail and metro technology centre
stories.summary: Hitachi Rail opened a C$30m global centre for digital technology development in the rail and metro sectors, occupying 5½ floors at the Consilium Place complex in Toronto’s Scarborough district.

stories.title: FBI Plans to Triple Counter-Drone Training Capacity for State and Local Agencies
Locally-built Stadler CHARME sleeping cars enter service in Kazakhstan
stories.summary: Stadler's first CHARME night train coaches entered passenger service on KTZ's 1 300 km train 3 and 4 service between Astana Nurly Zhol and Almaty-2 on November 11.

stories.title: Agri Spray Plans Shift to U.S. Drone Manufacturing as Federal Restrictions Reshape the Market
stories.summary: Agri Spray announced it will become a manufacturer of fully American-sourced agricultural drones within five years, citing restrictions imposed by the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) and the U.S. Department of War (DoW). The company plans to begin in-house software production this month and start assembly in Missouri, utilizing the DoW and FCC’s conditional approval program to continue using existing foreign supply chains while onshoring components.

stories.title: Viam Launchpad aims to accelerate robotics deployments
stories.summary: Viam established the Viam Launchpad, a six-month intensive program providing founders with usage credits, engineering support, and office space in New York City to accelerate robotics deployments. The initiative aims to help startups move from prototypes to commercial implementation by leveraging Viam's software platform and robotics lab.

stories.title: Airspeeder Names Pilots for Italia and GBR, Completing Five-Team International Series
stories.summary: Airspeeder named Patrick Lombardi and Dan Miles as pilots for Team Italia and GBR, completing the initial line-up for the five national teams in the inaugural Airspeeder International Series. The series' opening private race is scheduled for Adelaide, Australia, in November 2026.

stories.title: Zipline Proposes Up to 130,000 Daily Drone Deliveries in Arizona, With 24-Hour Operations
stories.summary: Zipline is seeking Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) approval for up to 130,000 daily drone deliveries across Phoenix and Tucson, with 24-hour operations. The proposal includes up to 65 charging locations and 1,300 package dropboxes in each area, using Platform 2 aircraft that carry packages up to eight pounds. The FAA is reviewing the draft environmental assessment and accepting public comments until December 7 or 9, 2026.

stories.title: Runway’s Praxis-1 world action model for robotics is now available
stories.summary: Runway AI Inc. released Praxis-1, a 27B-parameter world action model for robotics, making it available to developers with open weights under the Apache 2.0 license. The model, which predicts video and actions together, is available on GitHub, Hugging Face, and vLLM-Omni, and runs on NVIDIA hardware including H100, B200, RTX 5090, and Jetson Thor.

stories.title: Ukrainian Drone Company UFORCE Raises $700 Million to Expand Defense Manufacturing Worldwide
stories.summary: UFORCE raised $700 million in a Series A round at a $6 billion valuation to expand drone manufacturing for Ukraine and allied nations. The company plans to establish production facilities in the United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East to maintain output despite attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure.

also.title: UFORCE Raises $700M at $6B With UK and US-Backed State Funds

stories.title: Ukraine establishes six defence technology centres covering uncrewed systems, air defence and electronic warfare
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Ministry of Defence announced on 11 November the development of six specialised defence technology centres, including two already established directorates for unmanned systems and missile weapons. Four additional centres are planned to cover air defence, electronic intelligence and electronic warfare, space policy and technologies, and deep-strike systems.

stories.title: Samson Sky Appoints Cresa to Find Site for First US Switchblade Production Facility
Ukraine’s DOT-Chain Defence marketplace “delivers more than 1.5 million items to military”
stories.summary: Ukraine’s DOT-Chain Defence marketplace has delivered more than 1.5 million drones and other items of military equipment to combat units since its launch in July 2025, according to the country’s Ministry of Defence. The total value of equipment delivered through the platform exceeds UAH100 billion, with uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) accounting for the largest share.

stories.title: AeroVironment receives USD405 million international order for LOCUST X3 laser systems
stories.summary: AeroVironment received a USD405 million international order for LOCUST X3 laser systems to counter Group 1-3 uncrewed aircraft in the Middle East. The company plans to establish an undisclosed in-country maintenance depot for regional support and training.

stories.title: Zipline flies Chipotle burritos onto a PGA Tour golf course
stories.summary: Chipotle and Zipline completed the first drone food delivery at a PGA Tour event, serving golfers Joel Dahmen and Mark Hubbard on the 18th hole of the Omni Barton Creek Resort & Spa in Austin, Texas. The service, branded as Zipotle, uses autonomous electric aircraft to lower orders via tethered pods and is currently available to eligible customers in Dallas and Austin.

also.title: Chipotle and Zipline Deliver Burritos by Drone to PGA Tour Golfers

stories.title: Gulf Co-operation Council Railway project general agreement signed
stories.summary: Transport ministers of Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE signed a general agreement to progress the Gulf Co-operation Council Railway project linking the six member states.

stories.title: CONDOR Group acquires HHLA Sky to expand automated drone operations
stories.summary: Germany’s CONDOR Group announced on 12 November that it has acquired Hamburg-based drone technology company HHLA Sky through its subsidiary CONDOR International and Maritime Services (CONDOR IMS). The business will continue operating under the name CONDOR Sky, with HHLA Sky’s employees and its production site in Bielefeld becoming part of the group.

stories.title: Genesee & Wyoming prepares to split into three rail holding companies
stories.summary: Genesee & Wyoming Inc. is planning to separate into three rail holding companies, effective Jan. 1, 2027, a move that will position the regional entities for eventual sale. The companies will continue to be owned by G&W parent Brookfield and GIC.

stories.title: Horizon Aircraft Completes Preliminary Design Reviews for Cavorite X7
stories.summary: Horizon Aircraft completed the platform and system Preliminary Design Reviews (PDRs) for its full-scale Cavorite X7 hybrid-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) demonstrator. The company expects to begin issuing designs to manufacturing teams before the end of 2026.

stories.title: Intermodal leads U.S. rail traffic up 6.6% from a year ago
stories.summary: The Association of American Railroads reported that U.S. rail traffic rose 6.6% in the week ending Nov. 7, driven by an 11% increase in intermodal shipments. Carloads increased 1.3%, while motor vehicles and parts led commodity gains at 10.4%.

stories.title: ETCS goes live in Romania at last, but challenges remain
stories.summary: Passenger trains have started running under ETCS Level 2 on a short section of main line north of București after the long-dormant lineside equipment was put into operation.

stories.title: PODCAST: ZenaTech’s Phil Franklin on bringing Drone-as-a-Service capabilities to Arizona
stories.summary: ZenaTech launched its Drone as a Service offering in Mesa, Arizona, providing businesses with drones, pilots, and operational support through a subscription and pay-per-use model. The company plans to expand facilities to develop agricultural applications for businesses across Arizona.

stories.title: China's CCECC wins EU-backed contract to rehabilitate Montenegro railway
stories.summary: Chinese contractor CCECC has won a €16m European-funded contract covering the Montenegrin section of the TEN-T main line linking the port of Bar with Beograd, while an EBRD loan completes a €230·8m funding package for the Golubovci – Bar section at the southern end of the corridor.

stories.title: Katy Approves Zipline Drone Hub, the Only Part Texas Lets It Decide
stories.summary: The Katy City Council voted unanimously on November 9 to allow Zipline to build a drone charging station in the West Ten Business Park. The site will hold six towers serving a 3-mile radius, with deliveries potentially starting in three months.

stories.title: Amazon Wants Kids Inside for Drone Drops. Homewood Says It Wasn't Told
Anne Arundel Police Launch DFR Drone. Their Log Shows No Kings Flights
stories.summary: The Anne Arundel County Police Department was set to begin flying a Drone as First Responder pilot on Wednesday, Nov. 11, from an automated dock near Evergreen Road and Waugh Chapel Way. The department’s public log lists 18 flights labeled as No Kings events, a protest, or a public demonstration on the two days anti-Trump No Kings rallies took place in the county.

stories.title: Asics Says Corvus Drones Find Lost Shoes 60% Faster in Mississippi
stories.summary: Asics America flies Corvus One drones seven times a night in its Byhalia, Mississippi distribution center, recovering misplaced inventory 60% faster. The drones count high-risk areas monthly, allowing Asics to publish full availability feeds and sell stock at full price instead of liquidating it.

stories.title: Nampa Wants Amazon's Drone Flight Data. It Holds the Hub's Permit
stories.summary: The City of Nampa, Idaho, requested flight data from Amazon after Prime Air drones began flying over the city on October 30. Nampa holds the conditional use permit for the launch pad, which its Planning and Zoning Commission approved 6-1 on May 26, and can revoke it if drone noise proves much higher than Amazon represented.

stories.title: Spot Rates Up 50%, Rail Volumes at Highs
stories.summary: FreightWaves SONAR data showed truckload spot rates climbed 52% year over year to $3.56 per mile, while intermodal contract rates rose only 3% to 5%, creating a 30.2% road-to-rail savings advantage. October outbound rail volumes averaged 44,700 units, the highest monthly reading since 2026, before slipping to approximately 43,800 in November due to CSX and BNSF service interruptions.

stories.title: China’s PLA makes counter-drone training compulsory for infantry brigades
stories.summary: The Chinese People’s Liberation Army (PLA) made counter-drone training compulsory for a brigade of the 75th Group Army after an exercise revealed that thermal imaging drones could detect concealed soldiers. The unit introduced new manuals, tactical exercises, and dedicated facilities to detect and disrupt hostile drones.

stories.title: Royal Navy awards Saab GBP15 million contract for autonomous counter-drone radar capability
stories.summary: The Royal Navy awarded Saab a GBP15 million contract for Sea Giraffe 1X radars to integrate into Kraken Technology Group’s K3 Scout uncrewed surface vessel. The system will provide autonomous maritime surveillance and counter-drone capabilities, supporting the protection of naval assets and critical infrastructure as part of Project BEEHIVE.

stories.title: US Marines Turn Counter-Drone VR Goggles Into Suicide Prevention Tool
stories.summary: A US Marine Corps logistics battalion at Camp Pendleton, California, bought 20 OperatorXR virtual reality sets in 2025 for $200,000 to teach its Marines and sailors to hunt down hostile drones. Since July, the same headsets have also run suicide prevention training, and about 350 Marines had been through it by mid-October.

stories.title: Can a Drone Stop an Active Shooter? Brecourt Solutions Thinks So
stories.summary: Brecourt Solutions is developing a drone system that releases rare-earth magnets to jam firearms, targeting the weapon rather than the shooter. CEO Jeff Ross said the tool, which is in the research and development phase, has been tested on AR-style rifles, semi-automatic pistols, and shotguns, and he hopes to offer it to customers by the end of next year.

stories.title: Ring Launches Ring Robotics With Indoor Ring Drone Cam
stories.summary: Ring announced Ring Robotics on November 10, launching the Ring Drone Cam and Ring Rover Cam. The Rover Cam ships in the United States on December 16, 2026, for $999.99, while the Drone Cam ships on January 27, 2027, for $249.99, pending Federal Communications Commission authorization.

also.title: Ring's $250 Drone Cam Finally Ships January 27, Pending FCC Approval

stories.title: C-DOT Invites Innovators and Start-ups to Develop Autonomous UAV Payload Handling Systems
stories.summary: C-DOT invites applications from industry partners, technology developers, start-ups and innovators for the development of an Autonomous Payload Handling and Positioning System for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Selected project partner(s) will receive technical development assistance and financial support from C-DOT, subject to the prescribed evaluation and selection process.

stories.title: US rail traffic hits intermodal record as October freight gains signal economic resilience, says AAR
stories.summary: U.S. railroads set an intermodal traffic record in October, with volume rising 9.6% from a year earlier to an average of more than 298,000 containers and trailers per week. The Association of American Railroads said the industry is on course for a new annual record, citing resilient demand despite inflation and higher interest rates.

stories.title: TugVolt autonomous wagons to be trialled on Missouri railway
stories.summary: Intramotev will trial two TugVolt battery-powered autonomous wagons on the 35 km Columbia Terminal Railroad between Centralia and Columbia in Missouri.

stories.title: IAA authorised as Ireland’s Market Surveillance Authority (MSA) for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS)
stories.summary: The Irish Aviation Authority was designated as Ireland’s Market Surveillance Authority for Unmanned Aircraft Systems products under the European Union (Unmanned Aircraft Systems Products) Regulations 2026. The regulations come into operation on 11 January 2027.

stories.title: Memories.ai builds standardized egocentric video pipeline
stories.summary: Memories.ai is building a data pipeline for robotics companies that combines standardized video collection with AI-powered annotation to turn everyday egocentric footage into training data for robots. The San Francisco-based company provides a curated video data lake featuring egocentric video, along with custom annotation services and dataset tools to train robot learning models.

stories.title: Can AI agents program industrial robots without training data? Berkeley says yes
German Military Bans DJI Drones Again After Its 2023 Ban Didn't Stick
stories.summary: The Bundeswehr banned Chinese small drones from its barracks and training grounds with immediate effect, ordering units to stop flying existing models including DJI aircraft. The ministry stated that existing systems will be replaced with German or European products to strengthen self-sufficiency and technological sovereignty.

stories.title: Wheeling & Lake Erie engineers, conductors strike over managers filling crew positions
stories.summary: About 140 engineers and conductors at the Wheeling & Lake Erie Railway went on strike Wednesday, Nov. 11, over the railroad’s use of managers to perform conductors’ work. The union contends the practice violates its collective bargaining agreement and a federal court order dating to 2013.

stories.title: Jaunt and Vertiko Sign LOI for Proposed 10-Drone Cargo Fleet in Canada
Dronecloud makes drone flight notifications free and instant for every UK pilot
Analysis: Flatlining Indonesian high speed rail ridership complicates future expansion plans
stories.summary: Indonesia’s Whoosh high speed line carried 18.2 million passengers in its first three years, but daily ridership has plateaued below initial forecasts. Weak load factors and project debt now complicate plans for route extensions.

stories.title: Future Flight Global Targets Q1 2027 Launch for Florida Regional Air Service
Belgium announces Blue Dome air defence programme with counter-drone capabilities
stories.summary: Belgium unveiled Blue Dome, a short- and medium-range air defence architecture combining radar, missile launchers, and anti-aircraft guns to protect against aerial threats including uncrewed aircraft. The programme includes 14 GM200 MM/C radars, 10 NASAMS launch systems, and 20 Skyranger 30 guns, with first deliveries expected from 2027.

stories.title: Echodyne radar integrated into BAE Systems counter-UAS platform
stories.summary: Echodyne announced on 10 November that its EchoShield radar has been integrated into BAE Systems’ Anti Threat System (BATS). The modular counter-uncrewed aircraft system recently completed live trials in Scotland to demonstrate its ability to identify and respond to drone threats.

stories.title: NATO selects OSL Technology for counter-UAS marketplace
stories.summary: NATO selected OSL Technology, a Terma company, as one of five suppliers for its new counter-uncrewed aerial systems marketplace, announced on 10 November. The marketplace, launched on 5 November under the Drone Edge initiative, includes 16 solutions and allows Allied nations to procure systems through the NATO catalogue without separate tender processes.

stories.title: The 2026 EU Drone Summit – an urgent, overdue review of the Drone Strategy 2.0
ACSL sees 400% order growth, expands SOTEN pilot training
stories.summary: ACSL is teaming up with the Unmanned Safety Institute (USI) to give North American drone operators a dedicated training and certification program for its SOTEN platform. The new program is expected to become available in late November or early December 2026, with courses offered online and in-person options available for select training levels.

stories.title: Amazon secures landmark drone delivery approval in the UK
stories.summary: Amazon became the first operator worldwide to receive a SAIL 4 Operating Authorization from the UK Civil Aviation Authority, allowing Prime Air to expand drone deliveries to approximately 8,000 households around Darlington, England. The approval permits the MK30 electric drone to fly in densely populated communities, increasing eligible customers from roughly 600 to 8,000 and enabling deliveries of items up to 5 pounds within two hours.

also.title: Amazon’s Prime Air secures the world’s first SAIL 4 approval from the UK Civil Aviation Authority
Amazon's UK Drones Go From 600 to 8,000 Homes. The Circle Didn't Grow

stories.title: UK shared airspace project brings delivery and emergency drones together
stories.summary: ANRA Technologies, Wing, Manna Air Delivery, and Lancashire Fire and Rescue Service completed a drone airspace sharing demonstration in Chorley, Lancashire, with approval from the UK Civil Aviation Authority. The exercise used the ASTM F3548-21 standard to coordinate commercial delivery and emergency flights within the same Temporary Danger Area.

stories.title: Elisa and Sensofusion establish a joint venture to build a privately owned drone detection network
stories.summary: Elisa Corporation and Sensofusion Plc established a joint venture, Masthead Oy, to provide drone detection solutions in Europe. The venture combines Sensofusion’s technology with Elisa’s mobile network infrastructure in Finland and Estonia to support authorities and critical infrastructure operators.

stories.title: EXPLAINED | Ukraine’s ‘Peaky Blinders’ Hunt Russian Drones. What Does It Cost to Defend a City?
stories.summary: Ukraine’s foreign minister asked Washington to speed up deliveries of air-defence interceptors on November 10, the day Russia and Ukraine returned to US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi. Ukrainian officials said Russian attacks overnight into November 10 targeted five major substations, killed two people, and caused outages in six regions.

stories.title: TENCORE’s Autonomous AI KIT Module Enables Over 30% Savings in UGVs - Combat Unit Statistics
stories.summary: TENCORE is moving towards mass production of its AI KIT autonomous module for unmanned ground vehicles, with 210 kits scheduled for delivery. The system enables UGVs to carry out combat missions in conditions of complete communications and navigation denial.

stories.title: CRPF to acquire 'Kamikaze' drone system having 150 kmph full-payload speed with mission range of 15 km
stories.summary: The Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) is planning to acquire a 'Kamikaze' drone system with a minimum operating speed of 150 kmph and a mission range of 15 kilometres. The force has sought technical inputs from manufacturers by November 25, 2026, for a system capable of carrying high-explosive anti-personnel warheads.

stories.title: Agos Signs Series of Contracts with Major Domestic Defense Firms, Expanding Counter-Drone and Defense AI Businesses
stories.summary: Agos signed contracts with major domestic defense firms to supply counter-drone detection systems for overseas weapons exports and develop next-generation defense AI. The AI project runs through January 2028, while the company previously secured its first overseas mobile counter-drone export contract in August.

stories.title: Air Alerts Declared in Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia Over Drone Sightings
stories.summary: Air alerts were declared in Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia overnight after drones approached from Belarus. NATO fighter jets were scrambled, and operations at Vilnius and Kaunas airports were disrupted, though no drones were shot down.

stories.title: Russia claims interception of 146 drones in Leningrad region
stories.summary: Russia has said it has shot down more than 140 drones in an ongoing attack on the country’s Leningrad region northwest of Moscow. Governor Aleksandr Drozdenko said on Telegram on Tuesday that a total of 146 drones have been downed over the Leningrad Region.

also.title: Russia Says It Downed 146 Drones Over Leningrad Region
Estonia issues drone alerts as Ukraine hits Ust-Luga port

stories.title: Neolix X6T Autonomous Vehicle Enters SAIC Maxus Nanjing Factory
stories.summary: The Neolix X6T autonomous vehicle has operated at the SAIC Maxus Nanjing plant since July, transferring structural components from warehouses to the assembly line. Frontline operator Geng Fan noted that requesting a vehicle previously took at least ten minutes, but now a smartphone tap dispatches the autonomous vehicle.

stories.title: Topstar Unveils Industrial Bipedal Humanoid Robot Star
stories.summary: Topstar unveiled Star, a 172-centimeter-tall industrial bipedal humanoid robot, at the "TOPS DAY 2026" event in Dongguan. The 72-kilogram robot features 10-kilogram load capacity per arm and targets factory material handling, while the company signed a procurement agreement with Kaihang Technology.

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi Media Control: 3 Claims Unconfirmed [2026]
stories.summary: BASENOR reported on November 10, 2026, that Tesla Robotaxi riders can control cabin media via the native iOS media player, a claim Tesla has not confirmed in its support documentation.

stories.title: Greece to Receive Additional V-BAT UAS
stories.summary: The NATO Support and Procurement Agency ordered additional vertical takeoff and landing uncrewed aerial vehicles to expand the Greek Army’s V-BAT fleet. The contract covers the Greek Army and Navy and includes spare parts, ground support equipment and long-term sustainment services.

stories.title: Urban rail industry news round-up
stories.summary: Siemens Mobility won contracts to supply Signaling X technology to Taiwan for the Taoyuan Brown Line and Green Line Extension projects. In Russia, Moskva will expand driverless tram operations to two additional routes by the end of this year, aiming to equip two-thirds of its fleet with the technology by 2030.

stories.title: Voxel Attention Architecture Improves Autonomous Vehicle Detection in Severe Occlusion Scenarios
stories.summary: A research team from Beijing Jiaotong University introduced Multi-scale Occlusion-resilient Voxel Attention, a point-cloud perception framework that improves three-dimensional object detection for autonomous driving systems in heavily obstructed traffic environments. Published in Frontiers in Future Transportation, the architecture achieved a mean average precision of 63.36 percent on the nuScenes benchmark and 61.44 percent on an occlusion-focused subset, representing a 36.62 percentage point improvement over the CenterPoint baseline.

stories.title: Royal Navy Awards £90m Atlantic Net Contract and Signs JEF Drone Deal
stories.summary: The Royal Navy awarded Ocean Infinity Solutions a £90m contract for Atlantic Net, a North Atlantic drone surveillance network, and set out plans for a Statement of Intent with Northrop Grumman on 12 November to trial the YFQ-48A Talon Blue autonomous jet from carriers in 2027.

stories.title: China Releases Clearest Look Yet at GJ-11 Stealth Combat Drone, Claims First Live-Fire Strike
stories.summary: China released new official footage of its GJ-11 Sharp Sword unmanned combat aerial vehicle on Nov. 9, revealing internal weapons bays and an electro-optical targeting system. The release coincided with claims that two female drone operators scored a first-round hit during the aircraft's first live-fire strike mission.

also.title: Invisible to radar: China releases video of secret GJ-11 drone striking a target

stories.title: USMC Awards Textron Systems Contract for RIPSAW M3 Unmanned Ground Vehicles
stories.summary: The United States Marine Corps awarded Textron Systems a contract for two RIPSAW M3 unmanned ground vehicles. The vehicles will be delivered to the Marine Corps Warfighting Laboratory in Quantico, Virginia, for testing and evaluation in training and combat environments.

stories.title: KVN Fiber-Optic FPV Drones Strike Ukrainian Supply Lines
stories.summary: Russian forces used Knyaz Vandal Novgorodsky fiber-optic FPV drones to destroy Ukrainian vehicles and ground robots transporting ammunition, food, and heavy Baba Yaga-type hexacopters. The strikes disrupted supplies to frontline units and complicated troop rotations, restricting Ukrainian forces' ability to maintain forward positions.

stories.title: FAA Touts 2.2 Million UTM Drone Flights at AUVSI. Part 108 Still Waits
stories.summary: FAA officials reported 2.2 million drone flights processed under UAS Traffic Management since January, while the Part 108 rule for beyond visual line of sight operations remains pending at the White House Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs with a statutory deadline of December 7.

stories.title: Latvia, Lithuania warn of new drone threats as Finland adopts curbs
stories.summary: Latvia and Lithuania warned residents to seek shelter on Wednesday against unidentified drones entering their airspace from Russia or Belarus, activating NATO air defence fighter jets. Finland adopted temporary airspace and maritime curbs in the eastern Gulf of Finland as a precautionary measure to ensure bystander safety and counter potential drones.

also.title: Baltic nations briefly issue drone alerts as Russia, Ukraine exchange strikes

stories.title: Global tech firms eye Chinese robotics edge
stories.summary: Chinese robotics companies are increasingly becoming development partners with foreign technology giants, as overseas firms seek to combine artificial intelligence with the hardware and manufacturing capabilities needed to put humanoid robots to practical and efficient use. Chinese manufacturers accounted for more than 95 percent of worldwide humanoid robot shipments in the first half, according to market research firm IDC.

stories.title: United States: Secretary Mullin Joins White House Task Force at Drone Security Forum to Protect the Homeland From Unauthorized Drone Threats
stories.summary: DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin attended the Second Annual Countering the Threat: Drone Security Industry and SLTT Grant Forum at MGM National Harbor in Maryland, where leaders discussed counter-unmanned aircraft systems priorities and planning for the 2028 Summer Olympics. The event highlighted the Counter-UAS Grant Program, which provides $500 million over two fiscal years to help communities build drone-security capabilities, with the first $250 million awarded in Fiscal Year 2026 to 11 states and the National Capital Region.

stories.title: Tesla Edges Past Waymo in Texas Self-Driving Vehicle Registrations
stories.summary: Tesla now lists 1,302 vehicles in Texas’s automated-vehicle registry, five more than Waymo. The totals do not measure cars actively carrying riders.

stories.title: Driverless vehicles headed to Shreveport hospitals, entertainment district
stories.summary: Sportran is bringing autonomous buses to Shreveport, the second city in the nation to work with the technology thanks to federal funding. The vehicles will serve hospitals and the entertainment district, with Sportran Chief Executive Officer Dinero Washington stating that current positions will shift to create new digital age jobs.

stories.title: IATA Warns of New Aviation Security Risks as Drones, Cyberattacks and Bomb Hoaxes Disrupt European Travel -
stories.summary: Nick Careen, IATA’s Senior Vice President, Operations, Safety and Security, called for real-time intelligence sharing and closer coordination between airlines, airports, governments, military authorities, and law enforcement agencies at the Global Tourism Forum Annual Meeting 2026 in Brussels on November 10. He cited more than 25 recent hoax bomb threats and over 200 drone incursions in NATO airspace between January 2025 and October 2026 as evidence of new vulnerabilities requiring integrated responses.

stories.title: Connected Autonomous Vehicles Boost Network Resilience but Recovery
stories.summary: Researchers published a scoping review in the European Transport Research Review analyzing 106 studies on connected autonomous vehicle network resilience. The review found that research heavily emphasizes robustness and resourcefulness, while rapidity remains the least explored attribute, appearing in only 31 papers.

stories.title: Hegseth issues ‘corrected copy’ of recently unveiled counter-drone guidance
stories.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth issued a corrected memorandum dated Nov. 5 that removes references to a Deputy General Counsel for DRPM Programs and redirects legal reviews to the Office of the General Counsel through Joint Interagency Task Force 401’s legal advisor. The update modifies late September directives aimed at reforming approval processes for counter-drone capabilities.

stories.title: Australia urgently needs an air taxi research and development sandbox
stories.summary: Clem Newton-Brown of Skyportz warned at Global Drone 2026 that Australia risks falling behind.

stories.title: FAA Clears First Coast-to-Gulf BVLOS Flight for Skyways and Shell
stories.summary: The FAA issued its first authorization on November 9 for Skyways to fly a drone beyond visual line of sight from Gibson, Louisiana, to a Shell platform in the Gulf. The Austin, Texas company will inspect a pipeline right-of-way and perform a simulated equipment delivery using its V2 aircraft under a Section 927 waiver.

stories.title: How Robots are Delivering ROI in Mexico?
stories.summary: Mexico installed approximately 5,600 industrial robots in 2024, a 4% annual decline, with automotive manufacturers accounting for 63% of those installations. Annual installations fell another 7% in 2025 to fewer than 5,200 units, contrasting with an 11% global increase to 603,000 units.

stories.title: AutoPylot Maps Nearly 2,000 Local Drone Rules That LAANC Doesn't Cover
stories.summary: AutoPylot opened its Pilot Reports feature to all pilots in 50 states on November 9, adding nearly 2,000 local drone rules to its flight map. The company reviews submissions, usually within 48 hours, before displaying them to other users.

stories.title: Kakao Mobility, Nvidia form Level 4 autonomous driving alliance; Tesla Cybertruck to be phased out
stories.summary: Kakao Mobility will integrate Nvidia’s computing, sensing, and safety technologies into its proprietary autonomous driving software for deployment in Kia’s PBVs. The companies plan to introduce an autonomous driving computing unit equipped with two Nvidia Drive AGX Thor systems and apply Nvidia’s Halos safety system to software development and verification.

stories.title: Two Anduril YFQ-44A uncrewed fighters complete first formation flight with multiple autonomous jets
stories.summary: Two of the Fury jets were controlled by Shield AI’s Hivemind autonomy software.

also.title: US Air Force semi-autonomous drones fly in formation for the first time — Defense News

stories.title: Vietnam, Malaysia hold potential for cooperation in robotics industry
stories.summary: Dao Tuan Hung, President of the Business Association of Vietnamese in Korea (BAVIK), said Vietnam should prioritise specialised robots, including autonomous mobile robots (AMR/AGV), collaborative robots and machine vision systems, in sectors such as agro-fishery processing, textiles and garments, electronics and logistics.

stories.title: AUVSI Hands CEO Job To Counter-Drone Executive Brett Feddersen
stories.summary: The Association for Uncrewed Vehicle Systems International (AUVSI) named Brett Feddersen its president and CEO, effective December 1. Feddersen replaces Michael Robbins, who left for the Semiconductor Industry Association at the end of September, and moves into the role from a seat on AUVSI’s board.

stories.title: Path Robotics: $300 Million Series E At $2.45 Billion Valuation Funds Manufacturing AI Expansion
Funding Drone Innovation for the Last Tactical Mile
stories.summary: The Department of Defense committed more than $115 million to Unmanned Ground Vehicle projects in FY26 and launched Project Agincourt in late September 2026 to accelerate the development and deployment of autonomous military systems.

stories.title: Strathcona, CN Railway plan crude-by-rail link
stories.summary: Strathcona Resources and Canadian National Railway plan a C$2.5 billion to C$3.5 billion crude-by-rail link to Prince Rupert, British Columbia. Northern Express would transport 250,000 barrels daily and could diversify Canadian oil exports before the proposed Pacific Link pipeline begins operating.

stories.title: AllAI equips legacy industrial robots with AI control for autonomous work
stories.summary: AllAI equips existing industrial robots with an artificial intelligence (AI) control system to enable autonomous operation in changing work environments. The company has shipped over 1,500 control boards, secured purchase orders worth about 2 billion won, and is targeting 1.9 billion to 2 billion won in revenue this year.

stories.title: Tesla Private FSD Claim: $99 Plan, 0 Confirmed [2026]
stories.summary: A Forbes analysis syndicated on Yahoo Autos suggests Tesla private FSD may reach customers only through the Robotaxi fleet, citing a potential legal flaw. Tesla has not confirmed this claim, and the report notes that Full Self-Driving (Supervised) remains a $99 per month subscription where the driver stays responsible for traffic violations.

stories.title: Allen Control Systems launches new division to develop counter-drone lasers
stories.summary: Allen Control Systems announced the launch of a new directed energy division to provide high-energy lasers to U.S. and allied militaries for countering adversarial drones. The division will be led by Amanda Clark and John Mason, former leaders at the Army’s Space and Missile Defense Command.

also.title: Allen Control Systems launches directed-energy division focused on counter-drone technologies

stories.title: Ukrainian Drone Strikes May Cut Russian Oil Refining Capacity by 30%
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone strikes disrupted operations at nine of Russia’s 35 largest refineries, with a combined daily capacity of about 300,000 tonnes. Industry officials estimate the attacks may have cut Russia’s refining capacity by around 30%.

also.title: Are Russian and Ukrainian Drone Strikes Bringing the Baltic States Closer to the Ukraine War?

stories.title: Remote mine hunters silently trawl the waters as minesweepers go by the wayside
Ondas (ONDS) Stock: New Drone Contract Advances Mass Production Plans
stories.summary: Ondas Inc. secured a new purchase order for its Digital Bat tactical drone program on November 10, advancing plans for larger production. The company announced the acquisition agreement for ARAN Defense in August 2026 and expects to complete the transaction during the fourth quarter.

also.title: ONDS Stock Rises Overnight: Ondas Scores New ‘Digital Bat’ Drones Order Ahead Of Earnings
ARAPL Secures ₹19 Crore Order for Next-Generation Robotic Car Parking Technology

stories.title: EU-Ukraine drone alliance ramps up efforts to counter evolving battlefield threats
stories.summary: The European Commission held the second board meeting of the EU-Ukraine Drone Alliance in Brussels, where 18 founding members adopted terms of reference. Working groups are expected to begin activities in the coming months, and the board’s third meeting is scheduled for early 2027.

also.title: EU-Ukraine Drone Alliance advances joint development of drone defence systems

stories.title: EU pledges €60m amid mounting Black Sea threats and deadly drone strikes
stories.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced €60 million in extra EU funding for Romania, including €10 million for search and rescue operations and €50 million to fast-track a planned Black Sea Maritime Security Hub.

stories.title: Another Uber executive, Danny Guo, to depart
stories.summary: Uber engineering and science Vice President Danny Guo will leave Nov. 16 after nearly 12 years with the company. Guo oversees autonomous initiatives, Uber One and delivery infrastructure, with many of his direct reports moving to Chief Technology Officer Praveen Neppalli Naga.

stories.title: Initial buzz fades, hydrogen train witnesses routine footfall
stories.summary: The hydrogen train operating between Jind and Sonepat has seen initial excitement subside, with passenger numbers now comparable to other trains on the route. A railway official stated that 50 to 60 tickets were issued at Jind station when the train began its journey, while subsequent stations recorded good footfall.

stories.title: AI saved air cargo? Rates up 30% YOY
stories.summary: Air cargo rates rose 30% year over year and volumes grew 6% due to AI equipment demand, while Walmart deploys Wing and Zipline drones across nearly 300 stores. Zipline raised $1.5 billion and Wing will invest $125 million in a Texas factory ahead of new FAA rules for beyond-line-of-sight flights.

stories.title: D.C. Residents May Hear Drones Overhead the Next Two Nights. It’s a Drill.
stories.summary: Officials said the three-day exercise is being done to test technology that detects and tracks drones. The Metropolitan Washington Council of Governments said the exercise is not a response to a specific threat.

stories.title: GE Aerospace and BETA Technologies Celebrate World-First Milestone for Commercial Hybrid Electric Propulsion
stories.summary: GE Aerospace and BETA Technologies completed the world’s first hybrid-electric-assisted takeoff using a modified Saab 340B at BETA’s flight test facility in Plattsburgh, New York. The test utilized a GE Aerospace CT7 gas engine and a modified hybrid electric engine, with early observations indicating less noise compared to gas engines alone.

stories.title: Washington state port, short line win FRA grant to modernize 19 crossings
stories.summary: The Federal Railroad Administration awarded the Port of Pend Oreille an $8.92 million grant to modernize 19 grade crossings in northeastern Washington and northern Idaho. The port will provide a required $2.23 million nonfederal match for the $11.15 million project, which includes upgraded warning systems and signal circuitry. Port Executive Director Kelly Driver estimates the work will take around five years to complete.

stories.title: Rising Q3 transportation costs squeeze manufacturers, reward railroads and reshape trade
stories.summary: Ford Chief Executive Jim Farley said the company currently expects commodities, memory and logistics costs to represent a year-over-year headwind of about $2 billion. Union Pacific Chief Executive Jim Vena noted that higher fuel prices are naturally an advantage for railroads because they are much more efficient than trucking.

stories.title: Spain holds state funeral for 69 killed in high-speed rail crash
stories.summary: Relatives of the 69 people killed in a high-speed rail collision in Spain last month attended a state funeral on Tuesday with Spain’s royals, almost two weeks after the crash.

stories.title: Ukraine Upgrades Pluton System to Detect Mesh Modems in Russian Drones
stories.summary: Ukrainian defense technology company Infozahyst announced an upgrade to its Pluton drone detection system to identify mesh modems used to control Russian unmanned aerial vehicles. The update allows the system to monitor 1.5 and 3.4 GHz frequencies over a range of up to 70 kilometers, enabling remote monitoring of multiple units simultaneously.

stories.title: Ukraine and Poland sign agreement on working groups for drone technology
stories.summary: Polish Deputy Defence Minister Cezary Tomczyk and Ukraine’s Deputy Defence Minister Serhiy Boiev signed an agreement to create joint working groups on drone technology and countering drones. Tomczyk stated they are finalizing arrangements to transfer Polish MiG-29 aircraft to Ukraine in exchange for access to Ukrainian drone technologies and counter-drone capabilities.

also.title: Ukraine to Share Counter-Drone Tech With Poland in Exchange for Two MiG-29s
Ukraine and Poland to establish joint working groups on drone and counter-drone technologies
Ukraine agrees to trade drone tech for Polish MiGs

stories.title: Nvidia GR00T 2 Trains Robots With Human Demonstrations
stories.summary: Nvidia introduced GR00T 2 on Nov. 9 at the Conference on Robot Learning in Austin, Texas. The model learns from human videos and robot demonstrations, with code availability listed for December.
